The '''Magic shortbow''' is a bow that requires level 50 [[Ranged]] in order to use and can fire [[arrows]] up to [[Amethyst arrow|amethyst]].  It is one of the few [[Shortbow (weapon)|shortbows]] in the game with a [[Special attack]]. The bow has an [[attack range]] of 7, with  longrange increasing attack range by 2.

To make this bow, players must use a [[magic shortbow (u)]] on a [[bow string]]. This requires 80 [[Fletching]], and grants 83 experience. They can also be received from [[hard clue scroll]]s, or as a rare drop from [[spiritual ranger]]s.

The Magic shortbow can be [[Magic shortbow (i)|imbued]] by using a [[magic shortbow scroll]] on it to make a [[magic shortbow (i)]]. The imbue increases its ranged attack bonus to +75 and lowers the special attack cost to 50%.

The magic shortbow is often the most powerful ranged weapon available to mid-level players. Because of its fast attack speed and ability to fire [[Rune arrow|rune]] and [[amethyst arrow]]s, it is usually an effective ranged weapon for completing Slayer tasks. The [[rune crossbow]] is a viable alternative for players who desire a shield, the special effects of [[enchanted bolts]], or the easy availability of [[broad bolts]]. The [[Dorgeshuun crossbow]] can also achieve very similar damage-per-second to a magic bow with lower-level arrows (such as steel arrows), due to its higher firing speed than normal crossbows, while using very cheap and easily-obtainable ammunition in the form of [[bone bolts]].

Despite its low max hit, the magic shortbow is popular for [[player killing]] due to the ease of stacking its damage with a more powerful melee attack for a knockout blow.
